info.name: MasterFabric Go — GraphQL API (Postman) v0.0.2
info.description:
360° Postman collection for the MasterFabric Go GraphQL API.

Covers:
- Health (liveness + readiness)
- Security probes (nickname literal / authZ assertions)
- Auth: Register, Login (supports otpRequired + loginToken 2FA path), Login Verify OTP, Request Password Reset, Reset Password With OTP, Refresh, Logout
- User: Me, Update Profile, Addresses, Delete Account
- Settings: App Settings, My Settings (incl. otpEnabled), Update My Settings
- OTP (authenticated): requestOTP, verifyOTP — EMAIL_CHANGE for email updates (env **emailChangeOtpId**); plus otpCode / otpLoginToken for manual steps
- Admin: users, roles, status, deletion impact, sessions, notifications, mail SMTP (get/update/test/user send), OTP admin queries/mutations
- Device, Notifications, Todos (incl. organizationID / assignedToUserID), Organizations (incl. org project purchases GFG-113)
- Feedback: submit, my threads, admin list/reply (GFG-24)
- Teardown

Token flow: Login saves tokens when otpRequired=false; when true, saves otpLoginToken — run **Login Verify OTP** with `otpCode` from server logs / delivery channel.
Import `masterfabric.environment.json` alongside this file.
